summary: Barrett publicly declared he will 'always stand with Israel' as 'our nation's strongest ally' and with Jewish people facing anti-Semitism, framing the conflict around Hamas terrorism.
quote: I will always stand with Israel, our nation's strongest ally in the Middle East, and with the Jewish people who continue to face hatred and anti-Semitism here at home and around the world.

summary: FEC filings show Barrett received $70,232 from pro-Israel PACs all-time, including $43,746 from AIPAC PAC/United Democracy Project and $23,986 from Republican Jewish Coalition PAC.
quote: Tom Barrett has received $70,232 from pro-Israel PACs in FEC filings — $43,746 of it from AIPAC PAC and its super PAC, United Democracy Project, including $70,232 in direct and earmarked contributions.

summary: In the 2026 cycle Barrett received $58,331 from pro-Israel PACs: AIPAC PAC $44K, Republican Jewish Coalition PAC $12K, Louisianians for American Security PAC $3K.
quote: Tom Barrett has received $58,331 from pro-Israel PACs in the 2026 cycle, chiefly from AIPAC PAC (FEC filings through 2026-10-16).

summary: In a November 4 report, The State News says Barrett urged Michigan State University in a May letter to adopt IHRA’s working definition of antisemitism. The article discusses concerns about restrictions on Israel criticism.
quote: urged President Kevin Guskiewicz to formally incorporate the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance’s "working definition of antisemitism."
date_note: November 4, 2025 is the article publication date. The reported letter was in May; no exact letter date is inferred.
